Unsaved changes

Membership changes only when you press Save changes. Existing members keep their recorded 24H comparisons. If an addition has no historical 24H baseline, its current 1H value becomes the initial reference. An addition awaiting its first qualified quote has zero comparison weight. Its 24-hour warmup begins with that quote; it then joins the active members using real recorded history. Existing comparison weights stay unchanged while an addition warms. Roster weights apply to the separate raw 1H average.
